name: question-deduplicator
description: Before you ask a question in team chat, checks whether it was already asked and answered there. It searches your chat history (the last 12 months by default, 1 to 36 if you say so, or only the channels you name), reads the threads that match, and returns up to 3 prior answers: the original question and the answer as exact quotes, who answered, when, the channel and a link, labelled strong or partial match, acknowledged or not, and 'may be out of date' when older than 180 days. When nothing matches it says so and gives a cleaned-up copy of your question to post yourself. Read-only: it never posts the question and never answers it from its own knowledge. Without a chat connection it checks pasted threads instead.

skills.name: Prior answers
skills.description: Finds earlier chat threads that already answer your question: verbatim question and answer, who, when, channel, link, match strength (strong/partial), acknowledged, stale flag; or 'no prior answer found' with a restated question. Read-only.
examples: Has anyone asked how we rotate the staging DB password?
Check if the eu-west deploy timeout was discussed
